title: Finite etale lifting after adic completion
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I$ an ideal, and $B=\widehat A$ its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with projection $p:B\to A/I$. For a proper morphism $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], set $Y_0=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ and $Y_B=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Every finite etale cover $V\to Y_0$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] admits a finite etale cover $U\to Y_B$ and a morphism $j:Y_0\to Y_B$ whose Y projection is the canonical projection and whose B projection is the A/I projection followed by Spec(p), together with an isomorphism $U\times_{Y_B,j}Y_0\cong V$ over $Y_0$.

proof.text: Completion. Since $A$ is Noetherian, $I$ is finitely generated. Let $A^\wedge$ be the $I$-adic completion of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $\iota:A\to A^\wedge$, and $\pi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to A/I$ the projection. By [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-ideal], $A^\wedge$ is $IA^\wedge$-adically complete and $\pi^\wedge$ induces an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $A^\wedge/IA^\wedge\cong A/I$ with $\pi^\wedge\circ\iota$ the quotient map $\pi:A\to A/I$. By [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian], $A^\wedge$ is Noetherian. Put $Y^\wedge=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$; it is proper over $\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$ [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change]. Its closed fibre is $Y^\wedge_0=Y^\wedge\times_{A^\wedge}\operatorname{Spec}(A^\wedge/IA^\wedge)=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}(A^\wedge/IA^\wedge)$ (transitivity of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]), and the $A$-algebra isomorphism $A^\wedge/IA^\wedge\cong A/I$ gives an isomorphism $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$ over $Y$.

proof.text: Complete case. Via $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$ regard $V$ as a finite etale $Y^\wedge_0$-scheme. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting-complete] applied to the Noetherian $IA^\wedge$-adically complete pair $(A^\wedge,IA^\wedge)$ and the proper $Y^\wedge\to\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$ (step 1), there are a finite etale $W^\wedge\to Y^\wedge$ and an isomorphism $W^\wedge\times_{Y^\wedge}Y^\wedge_0\cong V$ over $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$.

proof.text: Take J to be the kernel of the completion projection; its identification with IB supplies completeness. The surjective first isomorphism theorem gives B/J ≅ A/I. Map pullbacks along its spectrum isomorphism, then paste to identify the closed fibre of Y_B. Compose V with this isomorphism and apply the complete-case theorem. Pull its over-category isomorphism back to Y_0. Pullback of an isomorphism and Over.pullbackComp identify this with the requested isomorphism. Both projection identities follow from pullback.map and pasting. This is implemented without any new sorry.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteEtale_completion_lift {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) : ∃ (U : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A)))))) (j : pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion I A))))), j ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ∧ j ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ I).toRingHom) ∧ Nonempty (Over.mk (pullback.snd U.hom j) ≅ Over.mk V.hom)
